edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the balance holder and sender in transfer, so caller identity controls token movement
msg.sender keys allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve, granting caller-controlled allowance
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, so caller controls ownership takeover
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner
